Description.Name: Hellion
Description.Details: Alicia "Hellion" McEvedy comes from the Deep Periphery, only disclosing that she had a strict upbringing she couldn't stand anymore. A hotheaded, capable pilot, willing to get into the middle of any brawl and surprisingly adept at making LosTech just work. She has a deep distrust towards ComStar and smiles sharkishly when someone mentions the Exodus. She was also known as a Pirate Queen by the name of "Lady Alekto".
